$comment: Pre-registered ladder arms. This file is VERSION CONTROLLED and is the
single source of truth for what an arm is.
Why it exists: the 0.4.1 ladder was launched ad hoc, with no runner and
no recorded argv. The probe header captured the raw slot arguments but NOT
which --zero-lift dials were applied or at what values, so those runs are
NOT exactly reproducible from their own artifacts. AGENTS.md forbids
reading a number from an unverified arm, so rung 6 cannot be faithfully
re-run. It is not restated here and must not be reported as replicated.
Every arm below therefore spells out all 17 slots AND every lift, and
run-arm.mjs re-reads the probe's own emitted header and fails the run if

flatline.title: Zero baseline re-verification under 0.5.0
flatline.hypothesis: With every energy-giving pathway zeroed and excretionRate also 0, all guilds go extinct on every seed.
flatline.prediction: 36/36 seeds reach total extinction (pop = 0) by tick 6000.
flatline.falsification: ANY seed reaches tick 6000 with pop > 0.
flatline.notPredicted: Extinction TIMING is deliberately not predicted. The 0.5.0 fixes changed gradient navigation, mating and predation yield, so the 0.4.1 extinction window (t2000-t5000, median t3500) is not a prediction for this arm and must not be compared as one.
confoundsControlled: --zero only, no lifts, so the arm is fully specified

consumer-yield.title: Consumer viability under corrected predation assimilation
consumer-yield.$comment: Predation yield moved from cd^2 to cd in 0.5.0 (a ~25% net gain at cd~0.8). This arm asks whether that alone restores consumer viability. It is a NEW arm, not a replication of the 0.4.1 rung 6, whose lift set was never recorded.
consumer-yield.hypothesis: Removing the doubled digestion tax raises consumer net yield enough to move consumers from ~0 into persistent three-guild worlds on a majority of seeds.
consumer-yield.prediction: consumers > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000, AND all three guilds non-zero on at least 12/18 seeds.
consumer-yield.falsification: consumers == 0 on 7 or more of 18 seeds, or all three guilds non-zero on fewer than 12/18 seeds.
confoundsControlled: 18-seed panel 41001-41018, identical to the 0.4.1 ladder panel
No consumerPhotoScale lift: per Owner directive only producers receive free energy
Not a replication of 0.4.1 rung 6 and must not be reported as one
